# Sill (Sill)

> Everyday Mac tools and components, together around your Island.

Everyday tools. Your own Island. A native macOS 14 or later app for files, components, and everyday tools.

## Facts
- Sill is a native macOS 14+ app with everyday tools, components, and an Island at the top of the screen. The main window is its tool and component catalog.
- Sill 2.0.0 build 8 is in TestFlight testing. Public TestFlight access and Mac App Store availability for 2.0.0 have not been announced. The App Store link opens the currently published release.
- Free includes Apps and Files tools, Clock and Weather components, and basic Island appearance, layout, shortcut, and display-placement settings. Shelf requires Pro.
- Pro includes Shelf, Note, Clipboard, and Translate tools; Pomodoro, Photo, and Island companion components; OCR search and sensitive-content protection; and included living backgrounds and custom image backgrounds.
- The Pro Shelf supports files, images, text, and links without an item limit, with search, editing, tags, pinning, batch actions, and Recently Deleted recovery.
- Pobb and Professor Aubie are characters in the Island companion experience. The website race is an illustration; Sill is not a standalone Pobb desktop-pet product.
- World Landmarks is included with Sill Pro and an active trial. Other extension packs follow their own availability and purchase terms; Sill Pro does not automatically unlock every separately distributed pack.
- Clipboard history is off by default. Pro users can enable encrypted local history, exclude apps, set retention, and clear it at any time.
- Stashed content stays on the local Mac. Translation sends submitted text to the selected service, and Weather requires network access. Files accesses folders you choose on this Mac.
- Small files are copied into local storage; large files can be referenced using macOS security-scoped bookmarks. Sill is not a backup service.
- Sill works on Macs with or without a display notch. It supports English and Simplified Chinese and respects Reduce Motion.
- Sill Pro is a one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase. The free 7-day App Store trial does not renew or charge automatically. Restore purchases using the original App Store account.
- Sill requires no Sill account. RevenueCat uses an anonymous app user identifier for trial and purchase verification.
